final_message:
The draft report for ABC Inc, June 2026, is written and the DRAFT banner is still in place. All data-quality checks passed.

**Data quality:** Every check passed, with 0 mismatches. That covers subtotals against their detail rows (to within 0.01), gross profit, operating income and net income against the workbook's own rows, and the balance sheet balancing. June is not flagged as a partial month. Table figures are rounded to whole units, so a difference worked out from the displayed numbers can be off by 1. For example, Software & Technology shows a change of 2,003, while subtracting the displayed figures gives 2,002. I added a note on this for the reviewer.

**Key points from the commentary:**
- **Revenue:** 195,898, down 6.0% on May (208,351, the highest month in the export). It is down 0.5% on the prior 6-month average and up 2.8% on June 2025. Usage Fees fell 6.3% to 166,782.
- **Gross margin:** 70.2%, up 3.1 percentage points on May and level with the 6-month average, but 4.2 points below June 2025 (74.3%).
- **Net income:** (330,756), the sixth negative month in a row; the trailing twelve months total (3,089,780). The only positive month, December 2025, is positive only because of a one-month tax benefit of (1,244,430).
- **Cash:** 713,481, down 215,543 on May and 1,871,836 on six months earlier.

**Correction to the "vanished expense line" flags:** The script flagged four expense lines as dropping to zero in June, but their monthly history shows only two of them changed in June:
- **Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous** (1,119 in May) and **Federal & State Taxes** (1,562 in May) did drop to zero, but both were already zero in several 2025 months.
- **Advisory Services** has been zero since February 2026.
- **Professional Fees** has had amounts in only 2 of the 18 months.

The commentary says this instead of repeating the flags.

**For the reviewer:** A Bad Debts credit of (1,806) turned the Finance & Admin category negative in June. The commentary leaves what it represents for the reviewer to confirm.

**"Other" category:** One account, General Expenses (149 in June), matched no category rule.
